frontmatter.name: shadcn
frontmatter.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".
frontmatter.allowed-tools: Bash(npx shadcn@latest *), Bash(pnpm dlx shadcn@latest *), Bash(bunx --bun shadcn@latest *)
